episodes.title: The Head Hunter
episodes.summary: A serial killer named Headhunter is terrorizing the country but is hiding in plain sight. Daniel Lee has identified a gene that can predict whether the baby is a psychopath 99 percent of the time.

episodes.title: Eye for Eye
episodes.summary: Decades into the future we see what became of the Go brothers and the headhunter. Bo Reum is at the prison entertaining prisoners with a magic show when he gets a devastating surprise.

episodes.title: Resurfacing Murder Cases
episodes.summary: Ba Reum realizes that Chi Kook's watch was found on a new victim and notifies Moo Chi. Bong Yi's grandmother sees something she shouldn't and is terrified by her finding.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.summary: Moo Chi feels that something is suspicious about Sung Yo Han, but he can't find any evidence yet. A boy gets kidnapped and Moo Chi gets a call from the kidnapper. He demands Moo Chi to find out the reason why the boy had to be kidnapped.

episodes.title: The Live Broadcast
episodes.summary: An hour-long live broadcast goes on air in hopes of saving Han Kook. During the live broadcast, endless tip-offs and reports from former victims of the predator flood into the broadcast station.

episodes.title: The Donkey and Goat
episodes.summary: While Han Kook is still missing and his life is under threat, the police haven't found any clues on the culprit. When Moo Chi gets back on his feet, he starts investigating Bong Yi's grandmother's case.

episodes.title: Memory Loss
episodes.summary: After a year, Moo Chi is assigned to a new team that collects and organizes criminal evidence. Ba Reum starts to work for a small precinct. On his first day at work, he accidentally finds a dead body.

episodes.title: Ba Reum's Memories
episodes.summary: Ba Reum's instinctive intuition helps Moo Chi get closer to the bottom of the mystery behind the knots. While investigating the suspects, Moo Chi and Ba Reum spot a man who stands out from the rest.

episodes.title: Ba Reum's Brain
episodes.summary: Ba Reum finds out about a shocking story behind his brain surgery a year ago. He's tormented by unwanted memories that keep haunting him.

episodes.title: Sung Yo Han in Me
episodes.summary: Ba Reum finds himself acting a lot more violent than before and realizes that it's getting harder to control himself. He even gets the urge to kill someone. Reum is terrified that the Yo Han inside him might take him over completely.

episodes.title: Kill Him! Kill Her!
episodes.summary: Ba Reum keeps hearing Yo Han's voice in his head telling him to kill people. Bong Yi runs into Kang Duk Soo, which makes her anxious. On a rainy day, Kang Duk Soo starts making a move again.

episodes.title: The Yo Han in Ba Reum
episodes.summary: Ba Reum keeps a close eye on Kang Duk Soo's murder investigation. Bong Yi on the other hand, thinks Moo Chi was the killer of Kang and keeps her mouth shut even when she's being speculated as a suspect.

episodes.title: DNA on the Weapon
episodes.summary: The DNA result found on the weapon that was used to kill Kang Duk Soo confuses Moo Chi. Bong Yi joins Hong Ju's team and starts investigating the Suseong serial murder case.

episodes.title: The Cat Killer
episodes.summary: Ko Nam, a bright and insightful kid finds out about a cat killer around his neighbourhood. One day, he promises to share his personal investigation with Bong Yi but unexpectedly goes through an accident. Ba Reum and Moo Chi dig deeper to find out who would've done such a heinous act to a little kid.

episodes.title: It Was All Me!
episodes.summary: Ba Reum starts to remember everything and is filled with guilt. When Ba Reum sees Han Kook's mother desperately looking for her child even after a year, he decides to confess his crimes and clear Yo Han's name. Meanwhile, Moo Chi notices that Chi Kook is lying and that he reacts strangely sensitive towards Ba Reum.

episodes.title: Was It Really Sung Yo Han?
episodes.summary: Chi Kook's sudden death shocks everyone and Ba Reum tries to convince Chi Kook's mom in requesting an autopsy. Meanwhile, Detective Ko starts to doubt that Sung Yo Han was the real killer. He starts to dig deeper into Song Soo Ho's past.

episodes.title: The Guryeong Family Massacre
episodes.summary: Ba Reum finally remembers what exactly happened to his family. He tries to set a trap to catch the mysterious OZ, and he finds out a secret about Dr. Daniel Lee in the process. Meanwhile, Moo Chi finds the unregistered car the OZ, the murderer who killed Chi Kook, used.

episodes.title: Please, Give Me Some Time
episodes.summary: Moo Chi finds out that Ba Reum was the killer and ferociously charges after him at the station. Moo Chi also suspects that Detective Lee is part of the OZ organization and tries to carry out an investigation on the two, but it's not easy. As flustered as he is, Ba Reum tries to remain calm to buy time until he figures out the killer of Chi Kook.

episodes.title: Kim Joon Sung's Laptop
episodes.summary: Moo Chi and Bong Yi get closer to the truth. In the meantime, Ba Reum tries to find his aunt, the last missing puzzle piece. Sang, who tries to confirm Ba Reum's alibi, finds something suspicious at Ba Reum's house.

episodes.title: Ba Reum's Final Call
episodes.summary: Ba Reum makes the final decision to turn himself in and finish one last mission that only he can do. Hong Ju also shares her big secret that's been tormenting her for years on her last show with Hee Jin, a woman who in fact was a secret agent working for Choi Young Shin under a massive private organization.
